items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: I heard Duke and I heard Charlie Parker and Prez along with Duke’s band

ctx.x: Storyville. George Wein owned that. And the big man in town was Jimmy Woode, the bass player, and Junior Raglin, whenever Duke would come to town would come by and sit and play. And I’d listen to these guys and I’m beginning to pick up on what they — I says now what’s so appealing about that? I says I can do that. And so on. And got a chance to hear Basie over at Storyville and I heard Duke and I heard Charlie Parker and Prez along with Duke’s band, and the singers, Joe Williams, and that thing “Every Day” that…
